fields.Name: IT21 - Open-App Metadata Teardown
fields.Description: Live proof of the Open-App metadata teardown seam (OpenApp engine × SQLDialect × data-provider), deterministic (no model calls). Seeds a *used* app (SchemaInfo + Entity + EntityField + a blocking NOT-NULL-FK RecordChange + a link-less nav Application) and drives the real RemoveAppEntityMetadata (the mj app remove code path). OAT1: the FK-graph cascade clears ALL of the app's metadata including the blocking RecordChange the old hardcoded-list path under-deleted. OAT2: the link-less Application is removed and can be re-created with the SAME fixed GUID without a PK_Application collision. The bundle seeds + removes all its own throwaway __mj rows.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The FK-graph teardown clears entity/field/schema-info + the blocking RecordChange; the link-less Application is removed and re-creatable at the same GUID.
